column1: # Game profile of Yoshi's Crafted World (Switch, update 1.0.1 = v65536)
# Good-Feel, Unreal Engine 4.18 era with Nintendo's NVN RHI, SDK 4.4.1. Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py) and brought up on the Mac (docs/agents)
# The texture streamer writes each unlocked mip level straight into the texture's storage, in CPU_UNCACHED pools (flags 0xe2) that need no flush; without both keys every
# streamed texture read 0 and the 3D scene was black behind the UI
# The NPDM declares no system resource: nninitStartup sets a heap of the pool less used memory (3.15 GB) in the 3.25 GB heap region of the 4 GB layout; GMalloc is a FMallocBinned on it
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# the decoded shader code archives: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders
# the rewritten modules are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory (Age of Calamity: 66.6 MB → 72 MB)
